medtop:01000000.label: arts, culture, entertainment and media
medtop:01000000.definition: All forms of arts, entertainment, cultural heritage and media

medtop:02000000.label: crime, law and justice
medtop:02000000.definition: The establishment and/or statement of the rules of behaviour in society, the enforcement of these rules, breaches of the rules, the punishment of offenders and the organisations and bodies involved in these activities

medtop:03000000.label: disaster, accident and emergency incident
medtop:03000000.definition: Man made or natural event resulting in loss of life or injury to living creatures and/or damage to inanimate objects or property

medtop:04000000.label: economy, business and finance
medtop:04000000.definition: All matters concerning the planning, production and exchange of wealth.

medtop:05000000.label: education
medtop:05000000.definition: All aspects of furthering knowledge, formally or informally

medtop:06000000.label: environment
medtop:06000000.definition: The protection, damage, and condition of the ecosystem of the planet Earth and its surroundings

medtop:07000000.label: health
medtop:07000000.definition: All aspects of physical and mental well-being

medtop:08000000.label: human interest
medtop:08000000.definition: Item that discusses individuals, groups, animals, plants or other objects in an emotional way

medtop:09000000.label: labour
medtop:09000000.definition: Social aspects, organisations, rules and conditions affecting the employment of human effort for the generation of wealth or provision of services and the economic support of the unemployed.

medtop:10000000.label: lifestyle and leisure
medtop:10000000.definition: Activities undertaken for pleasure, relaxation or recreation outside paid employment, including eating and travel.

medtop:11000000.label: politics and government
medtop:11000000.definition: Local, regional, national and international exercise of power, the day-to-day running of government, and the relationships between governing bodies and states.

medtop:12000000.label: religion
medtop:12000000.definition: Belief systems, institutions and people who provide moral guidance to followers

medtop:13000000.label: science and technology
medtop:13000000.definition: All aspects pertaining to human understanding of, as well as methodical study and research of natural, formal and social sciences, such as astronomy, linguistics or economics

medtop:14000000.label: society
medtop:14000000.definition: The concerns, issues, affairs and institutions relevant to human social interactions, problems and welfare, such as poverty, human rights and family planning

medtop:15000000.label: sport
medtop:15000000.definition: Competitive activity or skill that involves physical and/or mental effort and organisations and bodies involved in these activities

medtop:16000000.label: conflict, war and peace
medtop:16000000.definition: Acts of socially or politically motivated protest or violence, military activities, geopolitical conflicts, as well as resolution efforts

medtop:17000000.label: weather
medtop:17000000.definition: The study, prediction and reporting of meteorological phenomena

medtop:20000002.label: arts and entertainment
medtop:20000002.definition: All forms of arts and entertainment

medtop:20000003.label: animation
medtop:20000003.definition: Stories told through animated drawings in either full-length or short format

medtop:20000004.label: cartoon
medtop:20000004.definition: Drawings, such as editorial cartoons and comic strips, often using humour or satire

medtop:20000005.label: cinema
medtop:20000005.definition: Stories told through motion pictures, such as full-length or short format documentary or fictional features

medtop:20000006.label: film festival
medtop:20000006.definition: All forms of national and international film festivals

medtop:20000007.label: dance
medtop:20000007.definition: A form of performing art consisting of purposefully selected sequences of human movement

medtop:20000008.label: ballet
medtop:20000008.definition: A classical dance form based on formal gestures, steps and postures

medtop:20000009.label: modern dance
medtop:20000009.definition: A theatrical dance style based on free-style expression rather than formal gestures

medtop:20000010.label: traditional dance
medtop:20000010.definition: Dance style that reflects the life and culture of a specific group of people or region, such as folk and ceremonial dance

medtop:20000011.label: fashion
medtop:20000011.definition: Styles and trends in clothing, footwear, accessories, including the design, presentation and wearing of these styles and trends

medtop:20000012.label: jewellery
medtop:20000012.definition: Decorative items worn for personal expression and adornment, such as rings, necklaces, earrings

medtop:20000013.label: literature
medtop:20000013.definition: The telling of a story through written language

medtop:20000014.label: drama (literature)
medtop:20000014.definition: Work written to be performed on the stage

medtop:20000015.label: fiction
medtop:20000015.definition: Written works that are not based on fact, but are the creation of the author's imagination

medtop:20000016.label: non-fiction
medtop:20000016.definition: Written works that are based on fact

medtop:20000017.label: poetry
medtop:20000017.definition: Written works that use the aesthetic and rhythmic qualities of language to express a message or emotion

medtop:20000018.label: music
medtop:20000018.definition: A form of performing art using instruments or voice to create different sounds, tones and harmonies

medtop:20000019.label: musical instrument
medtop:20000019.definition: Objects used to play music on

medtop:20000020.label: musical performance
medtop:20000020.definition: Musicians performing for an audience for the purpose of entertainment

medtop:20000022.label: classical music
medtop:20000022.definition: A genre of music rooted in the traditions of Western music, including both religious and secular music, such as symphony, concerto and sonata.

medtop:20000023.label: country music
medtop:20000023.definition: A genre of music that originated in the southern United States, often consisting of ballads or dance tunes and featuring string instruments such as banjos, fiddles and guitars

medtop:20000024.label: folk music
medtop:20000024.definition: A genre of music that developed from traditional popular cultures, often based on story telling

medtop:20000025.label: jazz music
medtop:20000025.definition: A genre of music with roots in blues and ragtime that originated in African American communities of New Orleans in the United States in the late 19th and early 20th centuries

medtop:20000026.label: popular music
medtop:20000026.definition: A genre of music that is widely accessible and designed to appeal to all

medtop:20000027.label: rock and roll music
medtop:20000027.definition: A genre of music that originated in the United States during the late 1940s and early 1950s, evolving from African American musical styles such as gospel, jump blues, jazz, boogie woogie, and rhythm and blues.

medtop:20000028.label: opera
medtop:20000028.definition: A form of performing art where classically trained musicians and singers perform a musical and dramatic work

medtop:20000029.label: theatre
medtop:20000029.definition: A form of performing art where live performers portray a narrative to an audience through dialogue and action

medtop:20000030.label: music theatre
medtop:20000030.definition: A form of performing art where live performers portray a narrative to an audience through song, dialogue and action, such as musicals and operettas

medtop:20000031.label: visual arts
medtop:20000031.definition: A form of art which appeals primarily to the visual senses, such as ceramics, drawing, painting, sculpture, printmaking, design, crafts, photography, video, filmmaking, and architecture.

medtop:20000032.label: architecture
medtop:20000032.definition: The design of buildings, monuments and the spaces around them

medtop:20000033.label: design (visual arts)
medtop:20000033.definition: An artistic discipline which focuses on visual communication and presentation, the final product of which can range from jewellery to interior design

medtop:20000034.label: drawing
medtop:20000034.definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as pencils, markers, pen and ink, charcoal

medtop:20000035.label: painting
medtop:20000035.definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as oil paint, watercolour, pastel, crayon

medtop:20000036.label: photography
medtop:20000036.definition: A form of visual arts using photographic images

medtop:20000037.label: sculpture
medtop:20000037.definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as clay, stone, wood and metal to create three-dimensional works

medtop:20000038.label: culture
medtop:20000038.definition: The ideas, customs, arts, traditions of a particular group of persons

medtop:20000039.label: cultural development
medtop:20000039.definition: The history of the development of art and culture such as the rise of cave paintings, linguistic variations over time, the evolution of values

medtop:20000040.label: customs and tradition
medtop:20000040.definition: A particular way of behaving, or observances that have developed over time by a group of people

medtop:20000041.label: festive event (culture)
medtop:20000041.definition: An event ordinarily celebrated by a community and centring on some characteristic aspect of that community and its religion or traditions

medtop:20000042.label: language
medtop:20000042.definition: The method of human communication, either spoken or written, consisting of words that are used in a structured and conventional way

medtop:20000043.label: library and museum
medtop:20000043.definition: Institutions that house collections of books, music, art, or objects from the past and present optionally for public use and display

medtop:20000044.label: monument and heritage site
medtop:20000044.definition: Commemorations of historical people, events, or the areas containing them, in the form of structures such as sculptures, statues or buildings

medtop:20000046.label: news media
medtop:20000046.definition: The presentation of news to the public through different platforms, such as TV, radio, newspapers, magazines, web pages and blogs

medtop:20000047.label: newspaper
medtop:20000047.definition: Daily or weekly publication that presents the news, locally, regionally or globally, as well as features, opinion columns, comics and other content

medtop:20000048.label: online media outlet
medtop:20000048.definition: Publication distributing content, such as articles, blogs, photos, video and music, only over the internet

medtop:20000049.label: periodical
medtop:20000049.definition: Publication that is usually published weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or annually, such as magazines, journals or newsletters

medtop:20000050.label: radio
medtop:20000050.definition: Audio content, such as news, entertainment or information, distributed via broadcast or internet

medtop:20000051.label: television
medtop:20000051.definition: Video content, such as news, entertainment or information, distributed via broadcast or internet

medtop:20000053.label: act of terror
medtop:20000053.definition: Act of violence, often resulting in casualties, designed to raise fear and anxiety in a population

medtop:20000054.label: act of bioterrorism
medtop:20000054.definition: Attacks using biological agents intended to raise the level of fear within a population

medtop:20000055.label: terrorist bombings
medtop:20000055.definition: Intentional use of explosive devices on people, buildings or other structures

medtop:20000056.label: armed conflict
medtop:20000056.definition: Disputes between opposing groups involving the use of weapons, but not necessarily formally declared wars

medtop:20000057.label: guerrilla activity
medtop:20000057.definition: Anti-government or wartime actions by clandestine or non-state combatant groups, often using tactics such as ambush, sabotage, raids and kidnapping

medtop:20000058.label: international military intervention
medtop:20000058.definition: The temporary use of international forces in a country or region that requires outside help with resolving a crisis

medtop:20000059.label: peacekeeping force
medtop:20000059.definition: The military forces of a nation, or of several nations working together, whose mission is to maintain peace in areas of conflict

medtop:20000060.label: military occupation
medtop:20000060.definition: The temporary forceful taking over of a country or region by invading military forces

medtop:20000061.label: missing in action
medtop:20000061.definition: Civilians or military personnel who have gone missing during or after hostilities, conflicts or war

medtop:20000062.label: war
medtop:20000062.definition: Armed hostilities by one group or geopolitical entity against another

medtop:20000063.label: civil war
medtop:20000063.definition: Armed conflict between members of the same country, in some cases with the goal of dividing the country

medtop:20000064.label: war crime action
medtop:20000064.definition: Actions alleged as crimes committed during a war or armed conflict, usually against civilians or POWs

medtop:20000065.label: civil unrest
medtop:20000065.definition: Rallies, strikes, demonstrations, riots or other disturbances by a population, often in protest to a government or other organization's policies or actions

medtop:20000066.label: protests and demonstrations
medtop:20000066.definition: A non-violent public show of support for or opposition to a cause, idea or policy, in the form of a mass meeting or march

medtop:20000067.label: rebellion
medtop:20000067.definition: Organized actions of opposition to a government or ruling party by a country's residents, often violent and with the aim of overthrowing the government

medtop:20000068.label: revolution
medtop:20000068.definition: A forcible and often violent change to, or overthrow of, a country's political system or social order by internal forces, in favour of a new system

medtop:20000069.label: riot
medtop:20000069.definition: Violent, destructive events of civil disorder by groups of people, usually in response to a grievance or as acts of opposition, often involving injury to individuals and destruction of property

medtop:20000070.label: coup d'etat
medtop:20000070.definition: The overthrow of an established government by an organised military or political group

medtop:20000071.label: massacre
medtop:20000071.definition: The mass killing of people, usually civilians, during wartime hostilities

medtop:20000072.label: genocide
medtop:20000072.definition: The systematic killing of one clan, tribe, or religious or ethnic group by another

medtop:20000073.label: peace process
medtop:20000073.definition: Organized actions to end a war or conflict, usually involving peace negotiations and agreements

medtop:20000074.label: peace envoy
medtop:20000074.definition: Person or organisation initiating and carrying out a peace process

medtop:20000075.label: peace plan
medtop:20000075.definition: A strategy for achieving peace in a warring nation or area of conflict

medtop:20000076.label: peace talks
medtop:20000076.definition: Discussions between countries, world regions or geopolitical entities in conflict or at war, often with a mediator, with the goal of arriving at a solution for peace

medtop:20000077.label: post-war reconstruction
medtop:20000077.definition: Actions to rebuild a society, economy or political system in an area affected by war

medtop:20000078.label: disarmament
medtop:20000078.definition: The abolishment or reduction of a country's military weapons cache

medtop:20000079.label: ordnance clearance
medtop:20000079.definition: The removal or neutralisation of ordnance such as landmines or cluster bombs that may remain after a war or armed conflict on public ground

medtop:20000080.label: prisoners of war
medtop:20000080.definition: Individuals captured, imprisoned or detained by enemy factions during military conflicts or war

medtop:20000082.label: crime
medtop:20000082.definition: Violations of laws by individuals, companies or organisations

medtop:20000083.label: arson
medtop:20000083.definition: The intentional setting of fires with criminal intent

medtop:20000084.label: assault
medtop:20000084.definition: Physical crime against a person, including battery, brawls and threat of bodily harm

medtop:20000085.label: sex crime
medtop:20000085.definition: Sexual crimes against a person, such as rape, harassment, molestation or groping

medtop:20000086.label: cyber crime
medtop:20000086.definition: Criminal activities carried out by means of computers or the internet, such as hacking, phishing scams and identity theft

medtop:20000087.label: corporate crime
medtop:20000087.definition: Crimes committed by a corporation or by individuals acting on behalf of a corporation

medtop:20000088.label: anti-trust crime
medtop:20000088.definition: Violations of laws aimed at corporations to promote fair competition for the benefit of consumers

medtop:20000089.label: breach of contract
medtop:20000089.definition: The breaking of terms set in a contractual agreement

medtop:20000090.label: embezzlement
medtop:20000090.definition: The intentional theft or misuse of money left in one's care or belonging to one's employer

medtop:20000091.label: insider trading
medtop:20000091.definition: Trading of stocks by persons having access to internal information not made public at the time

medtop:20000092.label: restraint of trade
medtop:20000092.definition: Interference in free competition in business and trade

medtop:20000093.label: corruption
medtop:20000093.definition: Dishonest actions by a person in power in return for pecuniary or personal gain

medtop:20000094.label: bribery
medtop:20000094.definition: The giving of money or favours in order to influence the judgment or conduct of a person in a position of power

medtop:20000095.label: drug related crimes
medtop:20000095.definition: Illegal activities involving illicit substances, including buying, distribution, selling and smuggling

medtop:20000096.label: drug trafficking
medtop:20000096.definition: Dealing in illicit often harmful substances

medtop:20000097.label: fraud
medtop:20000097.definition: Intentional deception for personal or financial gain

medtop:20000098.label: hijacking
medtop:20000098.definition: Taking over a transportation vehicle by force

medtop:20000099.label: homicide
medtop:20000099.definition: The killing of one person by another, including murder and manslaughter

medtop:20000100.label: kidnapping
medtop:20000100.definition: To seize and detain a person against that person's will by unlawful threat, force or fraud

medtop:20000101.label: organised crime
medtop:20000101.definition: Crimes committed by gangs or criminal organizations, such as the mafia

medtop:20000102.label: gang activity
medtop:20000102.definition: Criminal activities by groups of individuals, who are allied by common territories, languages or ethnic backgrounds and identify by a common group identity by using a shared name, tattoo, hand sign, clothing style or graffiti symbol

medtop:20000103.label: terrorism
medtop:20000103.definition: Violence against people to create fear in order to achieve political or ideological objectives

medtop:20000104.label: robbery and theft
medtop:20000104.definition: The taking of another person's property without their consent, sometimes by force

medtop:20000105.label: war crime
medtop:20000105.definition: Crimes committed during a war or armed conflict, usually against civilians or prisoners of war, including the prosecution of such crimes

medtop:20000106.label: judiciary
medtop:20000106.definition: The system of courts of law

medtop:20000107.label: court
medtop:20000107.definition: Place where legal cases are heard and decided

medtop:20000108.label: appeal (court)
medtop:20000108.definition: Process in which parties request a formal change to an official decision

medtop:20000110.label: judge
medtop:20000110.definition: Official who decides cases in a court of law and passes sentences on those found guilty

medtop:20000111.label: trial (court)
medtop:20000111.definition: The process by which evidence is presented and guilt, innocence or culpability is determined

medtop:20000112.label: pre-trial
medtop:20000112.definition: Actions that happen before the start of a trial, such as pleas, bail motions, discovery and depositions

medtop:20000114.label: litigation
medtop:20000114.definition: Taking disputed issues to court for settlement by judge and/or jury

medtop:20000116.label: out of court procedures
medtop:20000116.definition: Legal issues which are settled outside of court

medtop:20000117.label: arbitration and mediation
medtop:20000117.definition: Resolution of disputed issues by a neutral panel, including conciliation, negotiation and tribunals

medtop:20000118.label: prosecution and prosecutors
medtop:20000118.definition: The process of holding a trial against a person who is accused of a crime to determine guilt and the lawyers and legal team who argue that the accused is guilty

medtop:20000119.label: justice
medtop:20000119.definition: The equitable administration of laws and regulations

medtop:20000120.label: civil rights
medtop:20000120.definition: Guarantees of protection to individuals  freedom from violation by governments, political and social organisations, and other individuals as determined by the laws or constitutions of an individual country

medtop:20000121.label: law
medtop:20000121.definition: The codification of rules of behaviour

medtop:20000122.label: civil law
medtop:20000122.definition: The system of law focused on private rights and disputes between individuals in such areas as contracts, torts, property, and family law

medtop:20000123.label: antitrust regulations
medtop:20000123.definition: laws to promote competition between companies for the benefit of consumers

medtop:20000124.label: regulations
medtop:20000124.definition: laws that guide the conduct and organization of business corporations

medtop:20000125.label: criminal law
medtop:20000125.definition: The system of law concerned with the punishment of those who commit crimes

medtop:20000126.label: international law
medtop:20000126.definition: The system of laws embraced by all nations, such as the Geneva Convention and the International Law of the Seas

medtop:20000127.label: extradition
medtop:20000127.definition: Legal transfer of criminals or suspects between countries

medtop:20000128.label: international court and tribunal
medtop:20000128.definition: The activities of courts under the authority of international organizations or formed by treaties between nations, such as the European Court for Human Rights and International Court of Justice

medtop:20000129.label: law enforcement
medtop:20000129.definition: Agencies that attempt to prevent disobedience to established laws or bring to justice those who disobey those laws

medtop:20000130.label: arrest
medtop:20000130.definition: The detention of a suspect of a crime

medtop:20000131.label: investigation (criminal)
medtop:20000131.definition: Inquiry into an alleged crime, including searching, interviews, interrogations and evidence collection

medtop:20000132.label: missing person
medtop:20000132.definition: An adult whose disappearance is possibly not voluntary, or a child whose whereabouts are unknown to the child's legal guardian

medtop:20000133.label: police
medtop:20000133.definition: Civil force of a national, regional or local government that is responsible for the prevention and detection of crime and the maintenance of public order

medtop:20000134.label: sentencing (criminal)
medtop:20000134.definition: The retribution handed out to those who break laws

medtop:20000135.label: capital punishment
medtop:20000135.definition: The legally authorised execution of someone as punishment for a crime

medtop:20000136.label: fine (penalty)
medtop:20000136.definition: Money that a court of law or other authority decides has to be paid as punishment for a crime or other offence

medtop:20000137.label: prison
medtop:20000137.definition: Facility where people are held as a punishment for a crime they have committed or while awaiting trial

medtop:20000139.label: accident and emergency incident
medtop:20000139.definition: A sudden, unexpected event that causes unwanted consequences or requires immediate action

medtop:20000140.label: explosion accident and incident
medtop:20000140.definition: Explosions caused by an accidental, non-combat, or non-terrorism source. Also use when the source of the explosion is non-specified or unknown

medtop:20000141.label: industrial accident and incident
medtop:20000141.definition: Any unplanned event or mishap in an industrial setting that result in injuries to people and damage to property or the environment

medtop:20000142.label: nuclear accident and incident
medtop:20000142.definition: Any unplanned event that causes unwanted consequences involving radioactive materials

medtop:20000143.label: transportation accident and incident
medtop:20000143.definition: An accident or incident involving one or more vehicles

medtop:20000144.label: air and space accident and incident
medtop:20000144.definition: An accident or incident involving aircrafts or spacecrafts

medtop:20000145.label: maritime accident and incident
medtop:20000145.definition: An accident or incident involving marine vessels.

medtop:20000146.label: railway accident and incident
medtop:20000146.definition: An accident or incident involving trains.

medtop:20000147.label: road accident and incident
medtop:20000147.definition: An accident or incident involving road vehicles.

medtop:20000148.label: disaster
medtop:20000148.definition: A sudden, unplanned event that causes great damage or loss of life, such as an accident or a natural catastrophe

medtop:20000149.label: famine
medtop:20000149.definition: Severe lack of food for a large population

medtop:20000150.label: fire
medtop:20000150.definition: Fires started by an accidental or unknown source. For wildfires, use wildfire. For fires started with a criminal intent, use arson.

medtop:20000151.label: natural disaster
medtop:20000151.definition: Destructive incidents caused by nature, such as earthquakes and floods

medtop:20000152.label: drought
medtop:20000152.definition: A severe lack of water over a period of time

medtop:20000153.label: earthquake
medtop:20000153.definition: The shifting of the tectonic plates of the Earth, creating in some cases damage to structures

medtop:20000154.label: flood
medtop:20000154.definition: Surfeit of water, caused by heavy rains or melting snow, usually in places where it's not wanted

medtop:20000155.label: landslide
medtop:20000155.definition: Sudden dislodging of massive amounts of snow or soil

medtop:20000156.label: avalanche
medtop:20000156.definition: A sudden fall of snow, ice, rock, or mud down the side of a mountain

medtop:20000158.label: windstorms
medtop:20000158.definition: A storm with very strong wind but little or no rain or snow

medtop:20000159.label: volcanic eruption
medtop:20000159.definition: A rupture in the crust of the Earth allowing molten material to escape to the surface

medtop:20000160.label: emergency incident
medtop:20000160.definition: A sudden, unexpected event that requires immediate action to prevent serious consequences

medtop:20000161.label: structural failure
medtop:20000161.definition: The unexpected collapse of a building, bridge or other structure

medtop:20000162.label: transport incident
medtop:20000162.definition: An incident involving one or more vehicles

medtop:20000163.label: air and space incident
medtop:20000163.definition: Incident involving craft in air or space.

medtop:20000167.label: emergency planning
medtop:20000167.definition: Planning for actions to deal with sudden, unplanned events

medtop:20000168.label: emergency response
medtop:20000168.definition: The planning and efforts made by people and organizations to help victims of a sudden, unplanned event, natural disaster or crisis

medtop:20000170.label: business information
medtop:20000170.definition: Information about individual business entities, including companies, corporations, charities

medtop:20000172.label: accounting and audit
medtop:20000172.definition: Changes regarding applicable accounting rules and the audit of accounting

medtop:20000173.label: analysts comment
medtop:20000173.definition: Stock analyst comments, analysis and recommendations.

medtop:20000174.label: bankruptcy
medtop:20000174.definition: Organisations that cannot pay their debts and file for special treatment by governments and financial systems

medtop:20000175.label: stock buyback
medtop:20000175.definition: Corporate actions in which companies buy back their own shares

medtop:20000176.label: credit rating
medtop:20000176.definition: Formal statements by certain rating agencies on the investment risk of a company or enterprise

medtop:20000177.label: corporate dividends
medtop:20000177.definition: Distribution of company profits to shareholders via dividend payments

medtop:20000178.label: corporate earnings
medtop:20000178.definition: Announcements and discussions of corporate earnings

medtop:20000180.label: financial statement
medtop:20000180.definition: Formal statements about the company financials typically delivered annually or quarterly

medtop:20000181.label: proxy filing
medtop:20000181.definition: Filings with regulatory agencies of proxy statements for upcoming shareholder votes.

medtop:20000182.label: financially distressed company
medtop:20000182.definition: Indications that a company is financially distressed but not having filed for bankruptcy yet

medtop:20000183.label: business financing
medtop:20000183.definition: The financing, capital structuring, and investment decisions of a business

medtop:20000184.label: restructuring and recapitalisation
medtop:20000184.definition: The sale of company units, splits of existing companies into units under a holding company, etc.

medtop:20000185.label: shareholder activity
medtop:20000185.definition: Actions taken by owners of one or more shares of a company, including shareholder activism

medtop:20000186.label: stock activity
medtop:20000186.definition: Announcements of major stock events: splits, block trades, new highs or lows, etc.

medtop:20000187.label: stock flotation
medtop:20000187.definition: The issuing of stock shares to the public for the first time, also called an Initial Public Offering (IPO)

medtop:20000188.label: human resources
medtop:20000188.definition: People working for a business and how they are managed

medtop:20000189.label: layoffs and downsizing
medtop:20000189.definition: Planned or actual reductions in the labour force.

medtop:20000190.label: executive officer
medtop:20000190.definition: Company executive officers including appointments and changes

medtop:20000191.label: stock option
medtop:20000191.definition: An agreement to either buy or sell a stock when it meets a certain price, sometimes used as an incentive for employees and officers of a company

medtop:20000192.label: business strategy and marketing
medtop:20000192.definition: Planning the direction of a company and selling its products and services to achieve the strategy

medtop:20000193.label: annual and special corporate meeting
medtop:20000193.definition: News surrounding company reports and annual or special corporate meetings

medtop:20000194.label: annual report
medtop:20000194.definition: Availability or contents of annual company reports.

medtop:20000195.label: board of directors
medtop:20000195.definition: Appointments to or changes in the board of directors for a company.

medtop:20000197.label: company spin-off
medtop:20000197.definition: The creation of new companies being spun off from existing companies

medtop:20000412.definition: The courses offered by a learning institution and the regulation of those courses

medtop:20000413.label: educational testing and examinations
medtop:20000413.definition: Polices and standards around the testing and assessment of students, including the merits of standardised testing, and testing methods

medtop:20000414.label: entrance examination
medtop:20000414.definition: Exams for entering colleges, universities and all other higher and lower education institutions

medtop:20000415.label: students
medtop:20000415.definition: Students as a demographic, including student protests and requests for change and trends among students

medtop:20000416.label: teachers
medtop:20000416.definition: Teachers as a demographic, including teacher unions, teacher education and training and the criteria for teachers in various locations

medtop:20000418.label: climate change
medtop:20000418.definition: All issues relating to extreme changes in climate, including rising global temperature, debate on the causes and solutions of global warming, greenhouse gases and ways to reduce emissions

medtop:20000419.label: global warming
medtop:20000419.definition: This category includes all issues relating to global warming including temperature research, remote sensing on temperature trends, debate on global warming, ways to reduce emissions and carbon trading.

medtop:20000420.label: conservation
medtop:20000420.definition: Preservation of the natural world, such as wilderness areas, flora and fauna

medtop:20000421.label: energy saving
medtop:20000421.definition: Conservation of electrical, and other power sources

medtop:20000422.label: nature preserve
medtop:20000422.definition: Land set aside for conservation and preservation of flora and fauna, such as national, state and provincial parks

medtop:20000423.label: environmental policy
medtop:20000423.definition: Government programs and policies related to environmental issues, such as pollution, renewable energy and conservation

medtop:20000424.label: environmental pollution
medtop:20000424.definition: The contamination of natural resources by harmful substances

medtop:20000425.label: air pollution
medtop:20000425.definition: Contaminants affecting the quality of the air

medtop:20000426.label: environmental clean-up
medtop:20000426.definition: The removal of hazardous materials from contaminated areas

medtop:20000427.label: hazardous material
medtop:20000427.definition: Materials that are harmful to humans or animals if they are exposed to them, such as radiation, poison gases, chemicals, heavy metals, PCBs, mircoplastics and certain plant products

medtop:20000428.label: waste material
medtop:20000428.definition: The environmental impact of waste, including recycling efforts

medtop:20000429.label: water pollution
medtop:20000429.definition: Contaminants affecting the quality of water

medtop:20000430.label: natural resource
medtop:20000430.definition: Assets afforded by nature without human intervention that can be used for various purposes, such as providing energy or industrial materials

medtop:20000431.label: energy resources
medtop:20000431.definition: Such resources as coal, gas, wind, sunlight etc., used to generate heat, electricity and power

medtop:20000432.label: land resources
medtop:20000432.definition: That portion of a nation or state that is above water and available for development either for profit or for the general good of the public

medtop:20000433.label: forest
medtop:20000433.definition: Open areas of trees either available for public enjoyment, or for commercial purposes

medtop:20000434.label: mountain
medtop:20000434.definition: Elevated land masses formed over the ages either by erosion, volcanic eruption, or movement of massive geographical formations called plates

medtop:20000435.label: population growth
medtop:20000435.definition: People and their growth and development within a natural setting

medtop:20000436.label: renewable energy
medtop:20000436.definition: The environmental impact of renewable energy, including solar, wind, hydro, biomass and geothermal

medtop:20000437.label: water
medtop:20000437.definition: Environmental issues about bodies of water, including oceans, lakes, streams and reservoirs, as well as ice, glaciers and forms of precipitation

medtop:20000438.label: ocean
medtop:20000438.definition: The body of salt water that covers nearly three fourths of the surface of the earth

medtop:20000439.label: river
medtop:20000439.definition: Moving water areas bounded by land that extend from earth sources and meander through land areas to join with other water areas

medtop:20000440.label: wetland
medtop:20000440.definition: Areas generally marshy and not either under water or dry land. Often related to aquifers for water quality and/or wildlife

medtop:20000442.label: ecosystem
medtop:20000442.definition: Interacting organisms, such as plants, animals, and bacteria, and their environment

medtop:20000443.label: endangered species
medtop:20000443.definition: Species in danger of disappearing due to factors such as changes in environment, hunting, human encroachment on their environment or changes in climate

medtop:20000444.label: invasive species
medtop:20000444.definition: Non-native plants, animals or other organisms that cause harm to native species by outcompeting them, altering native habitats or disrupting ecosystems

medtop:20000447.label: cancer
medtop:20000447.definition: A serious and often fatal disease caused when normal cells mutate into tumours

medtop:20000448.label: communicable disease
medtop:20000448.definition: Diseases that can be transmitted from one person or animal to another

medtop:20000449.label: epidemic and pandemic
medtop:20000449.definition: A disease that affects a large number of people within a community, population, region or that has spread to multiple countries or continents across the world

medtop:20000450.label: plague (disease)
medtop:20000450.definition: A highly infectious epidemic disease caused by the Yersinia pestis bacteria

medtop:20000451.label: viral disease
medtop:20000451.definition: Diseases caused by an infection by viruses

medtop:20000452.label: HIV and AIDS
medtop:20000452.definition: HIV, a virus that attacks the body's immune system, and AIDS the disease caused by HIV

medtop:20000453.label: retrovirus
medtop:20000453.definition: A family of RNA viruses such as those causing leukaemia and AIDS

medtop:20000454.label: heart disease
medtop:20000454.definition: Diseases and conditions affecting the heart such as heart attacks, the narrowing of arteries, arrhythmia or cardiomyopathy

medtop:20000455.label: illness
medtop:20000455.definition: Non-specific maladies such as stomach aches, headaches, flat feet, lumbago

medtop:20000456.label: injury
medtop:20000456.definition: Harm caused to the human body by external forces such as falls, weapons or accidents

medtop:20000457.label: medical condition
medtop:20000457.definition: An abnormal condition that affects the structure and functioning of the body, such as chronic pain, high blood pressure or osteoporosis

medtop:20000458.label: mental health and disorder
medtop:20000458.definition: The psychological well-being of an individual and the diseases and disorders that affect mood, thinking and behaviour as well as actions taken to bring improvement and awareness to these conditions

medtop:20000459.label: eating disorder
medtop:20000459.definition: Anorexia, bulimia, overeating and similar illnesses

medtop:20000460.label: obesity
medtop:20000460.definition: A condition of body weight generally considered 20 percent above the norm for gender, age, height and bone structure

medtop:20000461.label: health facility
medtop:20000461.definition: Facilities used for any kind of health care

medtop:20000462.label: hospital
medtop:20000462.definition: Medical facilities for the treatment of illnesses and injury

medtop:20000463.label: health organisation
medtop:20000463.definition: Specific health organisations, including professional associations, non-profit and international groups

medtop:20000464.label: health treatment and procedure
medtop:20000464.definition: Remedies, therapies, interventions, medications, testing and treatments to prevent, diagnose, manage or improve a health condition

medtop:20000465.label: diet
medtop:20000465.definition: Ways of eating to benefit health or treat a condition, such as plant-based, low-salt, high-fibre or gluten-free

medtop:20000466.label: dietary supplement
medtop:20000466.definition: Nutrients taken in addition to food to bolster health

medtop:20000467.label: non-prescription drug
medtop:20000467.definition: Chemical substances used in the treatment or prevention of physical or mental condition or disease

medtop:20000468.label: prescription drug
medtop:20000468.definition: Drugs that can be obtained only with a doctor's authorisation

medtop:20000469.label: medical test
medtop:20000469.definition: Diagnostic procedure, such as stress test, blood test, CAT scan or MRI

medtop:20000470.label: health care approach
medtop:20000470.definition: Different approaches to medical care that vary in the methods and substances used to treat symptoms

medtop:20000471.label: herbal medicine
medtop:20000471.definition: Treatment based on the use of herbs and other plants to cure or alleviate symptoms

medtop:20000472.label: holistic medicine
medtop:20000472.definition: Treatment of the whole person including mental and environmental factors in addition to treating symptoms

medtop:20000473.label: traditional Chinese medicine
medtop:20000473.definition: The practice of diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease based on traditional methods developed in Eastern Asia

medtop:20000474.label: conventional medicine
medtop:20000474.definition: The practice of diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease based on modern scientific research

medtop:20000475.label: physical fitness
medtop:20000475.definition: The measure of the body's ability to function efficiently and effectively during work and leisure activities.

medtop:20000476.label: preventative medicine
medtop:20000476.definition: Substances used to prevent diseases or illnesses

medtop:20000477.label: vaccine
medtop:20000477.definition: Medications designed to create immunity to diseases

medtop:20000478.label: therapy
medtop:20000478.definition: Treatment of physical, mental or medical conditions by non-surgical means

medtop:20000479.label: healthcare policy
medtop:20000479.definition: Government programs and policies related to healthcare such as drug policies, psychiatric care, health care funding and pandemic response

medtop:20000480.label: government health care
medtop:20000480.definition: Health care provided by governments at any level

medtop:20000481.label: Medicaid
medtop:20000481.definition: A program of the U.S. government to provide health care to needy citizens of all ages

medtop:20000482.label: Medicare
medtop:20000482.definition: A program of the U.S. government to provide health care to senior citizens

medtop:20000484.label: private health care
medtop:20000484.definition: Health care provided by private organisations

medtop:20000485.label: medical profession
medtop:20000485.definition: Profession requiring formal training in the study, diagnosis, treatment, care and prevention of disease, medical condition or injury

medtop:20000486.label: medical service
medtop:20000486.definition: Medical support for doctors, including blood tests and other medical tests on individuals, X-rays, CAT scans, MRIs, etc

medtop:20000488.label: geriatric medicine
medtop:20000488.definition: Specialty focusing on ageing and age-related issues including age-related illnesses, medical research, and trends.

medtop:20000490.label: paediatrics
medtop:20000490.definition: Medical specialisation that focuses on treating the young, including premature babies, infant care, childhood diseases and teenage health and behaviour problems

medtop:20000491.label: reproductive medicine
medtop:20000491.definition: Speciality of reproductive technologies like invitro fertilisation

medtop:20000492.label: medical staff
medtop:20000492.definition: Doctors, nurses, interns and others in a medical facility

medtop:20000493.label: non-human diseases
medtop:20000493.definition: Any harmful or destructive health condition affecting animals, plants or microorganisms.

medtop:20000494.label: animal disease
medtop:20000494.definition: Diseases that affect animals on a wide scale, including zoonotic diseases such as avian influenza

medtop:20000495.label: plant disease
medtop:20000495.definition: Disorders affecting plants caused by factors such as parasites, fungi, bacteria, physical injuries or environmental factors

medtop:20000497.label: accomplishment
medtop:20000497.definition: Achievements by individuals or groups, animals, plants or other objects, such as winning a competitive contest etc

medtop:20000498.label: award and prize
medtop:20000498.definition: The recognition of an achievement in a field in the form of a symbolic item, such as a plaque or trophy or in the form of a monetary gift, such as a cash prize or grant, given by a government or private institution

medtop:20000499.label: record and achievement
medtop:20000499.definition: Non-sport achievement by an individual or group that sets a new record, such as most books read or holding one's breath the longest

medtop:20000500.label: animal
medtop:20000500.definition: All animals, including pets, wildlife, insects, and livestock

medtop:20000501.label: ceremony
medtop:20000501.definition: Rituals, such as dedications, wreath laying or celebrating the launching of a ship

medtop:20000502.label: people
medtop:20000502.definition: Individuals or groups with a focus on emotional facets

medtop:20000504.label: high society
medtop:20000504.definition: Life and behaviour of the rich and socialites

medtop:20000505.label: celebrity
medtop:20000505.definition: Life and behaviour of famous people

medtop:20000506.label: royalty
medtop:20000506.definition: Imperial and royal family members in their societal rather than governmental roles

medtop:20000507.label: flowers and plants
medtop:20000507.definition: All plants, including flowers, trees, and shrubs

medtop:20000509.label: employment
medtop:20000509.definition: The state of having work, usually paid, for a company, organisation, or individual

medtop:20000510.label: apprenticeship
medtop:20000510.definition: A period of work used to learn a skill or trade

medtop:20000512.label: employee
medtop:20000512.definition: Those who are paid or otherwise compensated for providing services to employers

medtop:20000513.label: employer
medtop:20000513.definition: People and organisations that pay employees to provide services

medtop:20000514.label: employment training
medtop:20000514.definition: Learning new skills as part of an existing job, such as developing specialisations, learning new techniques or retraining when an employee's skills are no longer relevant

medtop:20000515.label: advanced training
medtop:20000515.definition: Additional training to enhance current skills

medtop:20000516.label: retraining
medtop:20000516.definition: Providing a worker training in new skills when his old skills are no longer applicable

medtop:20000517.label: occupations
medtop:20000517.definition: Generally one's trade, profession or business although professions are usually such things as lawyers and doctors, and occupations are such as clerks or truckers

medtop:20000518.label: wages and benefits
medtop:20000518.definition: Money, or other items of value such as pension contributions and health insurance, paid to employees as compensation for their work

medtop:20000519.label: employee benefits
medtop:20000519.definition: Benefits provided to an employee by a company, such as pension contributions, health insurance.

medtop:20000520.label: social security
medtop:20000520.definition: a government system that provides monetary assistance to people with inadequate or no incomes, such as retirees, disabled people or carers

medtop:20000522.label: workplace health and safety
medtop:20000522.definition: Laws protecting a safe and healthy work environment

medtop:20000523.label: labour market
medtop:20000523.definition: The supply and demand of labour in an economy

medtop:20000524.label: labour relations
medtop:20000524.definition: The relationship between workers and employers

medtop:20000525.label: collective agreements
medtop:20000525.definition: Negotiated guidelines for relationships between groups of employees and employers, including issues such as working hours, wages, health care, pensions and other benefits

medtop:20000526.label: contract issue-healthcare
medtop:20000526.definition: Element of contracts and contract discussions centring on health care issues

medtop:20000527.label: contract issue-wages
medtop:20000527.definition: Element of contracts and contract discussions centring on remuneration

medtop:20000528.label: contract issue-work rules
medtop:20000528.definition: Element of contracts and contract discussions centring on rules affecting issues such as lunch and other breaks, work shifts, vacation scheduling, seniority, sick leave etc.

medtop:20000529.label: labour dispute
medtop:20000529.definition: Disagreements between employers and employees regarding work conditions, pay or other issues

medtop:20000530.label: labour strike
medtop:20000530.definition: Groups of employees agreeing to cease work activities with the aim of achieving better pay or work conditions

medtop:20000532.label: pension
medtop:20000532.definition: Payments, either government or private, to retired people

medtop:20000533.label: unemployment
medtop:20000533.definition: The state of being available to work but not having a job

medtop:20000534.label: job layoffs
medtop:20000534.definition: The reduction of a company's work force through dismissal because of changing economic factors

medtop:20000535.label: unemployment benefits
medtop:20000535.definition: Monetary compensation paid to the jobless

medtop:20000536.label: unions
medtop:20000536.definition: Groups established to represent bodies of workers in order to obtain better workplace conditions through collective bargaining

medtop:20000538.label: leisure
medtop:20000538.definition: Activities carried out in ones' spare time and not in a competitive way.

medtop:20000539.label: club and association
medtop:20000539.definition: Organisations joined by individuals because of similar interests

medtop:20000541.label: board game
medtop:20000541.definition: A game played on a board

medtop:20000542.label: card game
medtop:20000542.definition: A game played with a pack of cards

medtop:20000543.label: children's game
medtop:20000543.definition: A game designed for and most often played by children

medtop:20000544.label: dice game
medtop:20000544.definition: A game played using dice only

medtop:20000545.label: outdoor game
medtop:20000545.definition: A game played in an open space

medtop:20000546.label: puzzle
medtop:20000546.definition: A game played solving logic problems for entertainment

medtop:20000548.label: video game
medtop:20000548.definition: A game played using a video display

medtop:20000549.label: gaming and lottery
medtop:20000549.definition: Gambling, often involving selection of sets of numbers one expects to come up

medtop:20000551.label: holiday
medtop:20000551.definition: Time spent not at work for rest and relaxation

medtop:20000552.label: public holiday
medtop:20000552.definition: A day of celebration declared by a government

medtop:20000553.label: leisure venue
medtop:20000553.definition: A place where people go to be entertained or amused. For sporting events, use sport venue.

medtop:20000554.label: amusement park
medtop:20000554.definition: A park providing various rides and entertainment attractions for both adults and children, including theme parks

medtop:20000555.label: bar
medtop:20000555.definition: A business where drinks are prepared and served to the public for consumption on the premises

medtop:20000556.label: cafe
medtop:20000556.definition: A small business where drinks and snacks are prepared and served - its specifics may depend on the local culture

medtop:20000557.label: nightclub
medtop:20000557.definition: A commercial establishment providing music, or other entertainment along with food and drink to selected clientele

medtop:20000558.label: restaurant
medtop:20000558.definition: A business where meals are prepared and served to the public

medtop:20000559.label: sports facilities
medtop:20000559.definition: Gymnasiums, stadiums or arenas where sports events take place

medtop:20000560.label: outdoor recreational activities
medtop:20000560.definition: Leisure activities engaged in the outdoors, most commonly in natural settings

medtop:20000561.label: fishing
medtop:20000561.definition: A recreational activity involving the use of baits, lures, weapons and traps for the capture of aquatic species.

medtop:20000562.label: hunting
medtop:20000562.definition: An activity involving the use of weapons or traps for the capturing of animals

medtop:20000563.label: travel and tourism
medtop:20000563.definition: Spending time away from home in pursuit of recreation, relaxation or pleasure

medtop:20000564.label: tourism
medtop:20000564.definition: Leisure travel involving visits to a number of locations and/or countries over an extended period of time, often as part of an organised group

medtop:20000565.label: lifestyle
medtop:20000565.definition: The way in which a person lives, including their style and possessions

medtop:20000566.label: automobile enthusiasm
medtop:20000566.definition: Interest in new and classic cars

medtop:20000567.label: bicycle enthusiasm
medtop:20000567.definition: Interest in new and classic manpowered cycles

medtop:20000569.label: organic food
medtop:20000569.definition: Food which is grown using no artificial fertilisers or chemical compounds

medtop:20000570.label: house and home
medtop:20000570.definition: Interest in maintaining and decorating one's home

medtop:20000571.label: motorcycle enthusiasm
medtop:20000571.definition: Interest in new and classic motor-powered cycles

medtop:20000572.label: trend
medtop:20000572.definition: Interest in what is considered hip or popular at a certain point in time

medtop:20000574.label: election
medtop:20000574.definition: The selection of government representatives by the casting of votes by the populace

medtop:20000575.label: citizens' initiative and recall
medtop:20000575.definition: Political suggestions by non-government officials for corrective action, or for changes in existing rules and regulations

medtop:20000576.label: voting system
medtop:20000576.definition: The set of rules that determine how elections are conducted and how their results are determined, including discussions of the electoral college, ranked choice voting or the allocation of governmental seats

medtop:20000577.label: intergovernmental elections
medtop:20000577.definition: Choosing individuals for the leadership of an international organisation, such as the United Nations, European Union, NATO and World Bank

medtop:20000578.label: local elections
medtop:20000578.definition: Choosing individuals for government at the city, village or county level

medtop:20000579.label: national elections
medtop:20000579.definition: Choosing individuals for government at a national level

medtop:20000581.label: campaign finance
medtop:20000581.definition: The money that makes campaigns for public office possible

medtop:20000582.label: political candidates
medtop:20000582.definition: Individuals who are chosen to stand for office

medtop:20000583.label: primary elections
medtop:20000583.definition: Preliminary elections or caucuses to choose candidates to represent a political party in a regional or national election

medtop:20000584.label: referendum
medtop:20000584.definition: Political proposals, laws and actions to be voted on by the entire voting body, including ballot measures and citizens' initiatives

medtop:20000585.label: regional elections
medtop:20000585.definition: Choosing individuals for government at a regional, state or province level

medtop:20000586.label: voting
medtop:20000586.definition: The act of casting a ballot for a candidate, a party or an initiative in a political election, including voting machines, voting by mail or voter turnout

medtop:20000587.label: fundamental rights
medtop:20000587.definition: The political, social, cultural and economic rights to which all people are entitled, usually upheld by law

medtop:20000588.label: censorship and freedom of speech
medtop:20000588.definition: The right to express opinions without restraint and attempts to supress speech by an organisation or individual

medtop:20000590.label: freedom of religion
medtop:20000590.definition: The right to practice the religion of one's choosing and efforts to violate this right through the intimidation of believers or laws that encroach on religious rituals

medtop:20000591.label: freedom of the press
medtop:20000591.definition: The right of the press to report on stories freely and efforts by governments, organizations or individuals to suppress, jail or kill journalists who are reporting the news

medtop:20000592.label: human rights
medtop:20000592.definition: Rights entitled to be enjoyed by all people universally

medtop:20000593.label: government
medtop:20000593.definition: The systems, institutions and people who run a political entity

medtop:20000594.label: civil and public service
medtop:20000594.definition: The paid service by civilians for the government, and the often non-paid service of individuals for the benefit of others (public service)

medtop:20000595.label: government employee
medtop:20000595.definition: Individuals employed by a government at all levels

medtop:20000596.label: public officials
medtop:20000596.definition: Individuals who are elected or appointed to positions in the government

medtop:20000597.label: constitution (law)
medtop:20000597.definition: A basic framework that stands above all laws and regulations, specifying how a particular political entity is governed

medtop:20000598.label: national security
medtop:20000598.definition: The protection of a political entity

medtop:20000599.label: armed forces
medtop:20000599.definition: The organizations and individuals that serve as part of the military of a political entity

medtop:20000600.label: veterans' affairs
medtop:20000600.definition: Care and provision for those who served in the military

medtop:20000601.label: military equipment
medtop:20000601.definition: Equipment issued to members of the armed forces

medtop:20000602.label: military weaponry and equipment
medtop:20000602.definition: The equipment and weapons used by armed forces and the trade of armaments between political entities

medtop:20000603.label: security measures (defence)
medtop:20000603.definition: Means of making a nation, a state, a building or a person secure from harm and outside interference.

medtop:20000604.label: national security
medtop:20000604.definition: The philosophy of securing a nation and its borders, as well as the well-being of its citizens

medtop:20000606.label: executive (government)
medtop:20000606.definition: Branch of government that is responsible for implementing the laws passed by the legislative branch, sometimes led by a prime minister or president

medtop:20000607.label: government budget
medtop:20000607.definition: The proposed expenses and revenues approved by the legislature.

medtop:20000608.label: public finance
medtop:20000608.definition: The money of government used for paying for public programmes and services and public debt

medtop:20000609.label: government department
medtop:20000609.definition: Divisions of a government that concentrate on specific areas such as health, welfare, economy or war

medtop:20000610.label: head of state
medtop:20000610.definition: Symbolic or actual chief representative of a nation, such as a monarch, president or emir

medtop:20000611.label: impeachment
medtop:20000611.definition: The process of bringing a public official before a tribunal to answer charges of wrongdoing

medtop:20000612.label: local authority
medtop:20000612.definition: Authorities at borough, city or county level

medtop:20000613.label: minister or secretary (government)
medtop:20000613.definition: Senior government official, either elected or appointed, who heads a government department or leads an initiative

medtop:20000614.label: national government
medtop:20000614.definition: The ruling body of a nation

medtop:20000615.label: legislative body
medtop:20000615.definition: A legislature of elected officials representing the people that has the authority to make laws

medtop:20000616.label: lower house (legislature)
medtop:20000616.definition: Lower chamber of a legislative body, such as the US House of Representatives or UK House of Commons

medtop:20000617.label: upper house (legislature)
medtop:20000617.definition: Senior chamber of a legislative body, such as the US Senate or UK House of Lords

medtop:20000618.label: regional authority
medtop:20000618.definition: Authorities at a level above the local and below the national, such as a state or province

medtop:20000619.label: safety of citizens
medtop:20000619.definition: Government policies to protect the well-being of its citizens

medtop:20000620.label: taxation policy
medtop:20000620.definition: Government programmes and policies around the taxation of citizens and entities

medtop:20000621.label: government policy
medtop:20000621.definition: An overall plan or course of action set out by a government intended to influence and guide decisions

medtop:20000623.label: nationalisation
medtop:20000623.definition: State takeover of private organisations or properties

medtop:20000624.label: privatisation
medtop:20000624.definition: The transfer of state-owned organisations or properties to private owners

medtop:20000625.label: state-owned enterprise
medtop:20000625.definition: Enterprises owned partially or completely by the government

medtop:20000627.label: data protection policy
medtop:20000627.definition: Efforts to protect personal information in written, oral or electronic form and regulations around what personal information can be collected by the government or other entities

medtop:20000628.label: housing and urban planning policy
medtop:20000628.definition: Systematic planning of urban and suburban areas and the housing within those areas

medtop:20000629.label: policy towards indigenous people
medtop:20000629.definition: Government progams and policies toward indigenous peoples, such as land allocation, rights protection and financial support

medtop:20000630.label: pension and welfare policy
medtop:20000630.definition: Government policies supporting citizens financially through programs such as unemployment payments, pensions and financial support for the poor

medtop:20000631.label: personal data collection policy
medtop:20000631.definition: The collection, by government or other entities of information on individuals

medtop:20000632.label: personal weapon control policy
medtop:20000632.definition: Government policies and regulations around the personal ownership of firearms and other weapons

medtop:20000633.label: planning inquiries
medtop:20000633.definition: Public hearings or planning inquiries on proposed constructions, e.g. Construction of water driven power station in a National Park.

medtop:20000634.label: immigration policy
medtop:20000634.definition: Policies around immigration into a country such as who may immigrate to a country, how many people are allowed in each year, deportation of illegal immigrants and integration programmes that help new immigrants assimilate to a country's culture

medtop:20000635.label: nuclear policy
medtop:20000635.definition: Government policies around the production of use of nuclear power and weapons

medtop:20000636.label: regulation of industry
medtop:20000636.definition: Government regulation dictating how companies operate

medtop:20000637.label: food and drink regulations
medtop:20000637.definition: Government policies relating to the production and selling of food and drink, including ensuring food safety

medtop:20000638.label: international relations
medtop:20000638.definition: Relations between nations through negotiation, treaty, or diplomacy

medtop:20000639.label: diplomacy
medtop:20000639.definition: Negotiations between representatives of nations or groups of nations and the diplomats who are involved in the talks

medtop:20000640.label: summit meeting
medtop:20000640.definition: Meetings between high-level government officials or heads of state for the purpose of diplomatic negotiations to ease international tensions or to discuss common goals

medtop:20000641.label: treaty
medtop:20000641.definition: A written agreement between international entities that is binding under international law

medtop:20000642.label: economic sanction
medtop:20000642.definition: Economic measures taken by one country or intergovernmental agency against another such as trade restrictions and embargoes

medtop:20000643.label: foreign aid
medtop:20000643.definition: Support from one nation to another for purposes such as disaster, general economic development or diplomacy

medtop:20000644.label: international organisation
medtop:20000644.definition: Organisation with members and functions that cross international borders

medtop:20000645.label: refugees and internally displaced people
medtop:20000645.definition: People seeking shelter or asylum in another region because of some fear of persecution, conflict, or natural disaster in their own region

medtop:20000646.label: non-governmental organisation (NGO)
medtop:20000646.definition: Groups officially outside of government that lobby, demonstrate or campaign on a wide range of issues such as economics, the environment and healthcare

medtop:20000647.label: political crisis
medtop:20000647.definition: Conflict that rises to a level where, depending on events, governments can fall etc

medtop:20000648.label: political prisoners and dissenters
medtop:20000648.definition: Individuals who put themselves at risk by expressing their political views and the imprisonment of individuals who speak out against a political authority

medtop:20000649.label: political process
medtop:20000649.definition: The art or science of participating in the affairs of government, a state of political party

medtop:20000650.label: lobbying
medtop:20000650.definition: Advocacy to influence legislators or government officials

medtop:20000651.label: political parties and movements
medtop:20000651.definition: Covers both formally recognised and informal political associations

medtop:20000652.label: political development
medtop:20000652.definition: The creation and rise of political systems and the history of the people and nations that are associated with those systems.

medtop:20000653.label: political system
medtop:20000653.definition: The form of government that is observed, recognised or otherwise declared by a society or state

medtop:20000654.label: democracy
medtop:20000654.definition: Form of government in which the people hold the power, either directly or through elected officials

medtop:20000655.label: dictatorship
medtop:20000655.definition: Form of government in which a single individual or a small group of individuals hold power without the consent of the people

medtop:20000657.label: belief systems
medtop:20000657.definition: A set of beliefs prescribed by an institution or text often focusing on the worship of a higher power and the outlining of moral guidelines

medtop:20000658.label: Buddhism
medtop:20000658.definition: An Asian religion founded in the 6th century BC in India based on the teachings of the Buddha with the goal of overcoming suffering and transcending desire and the individual self to achieve nirvana

medtop:20000659.label: Christianity
medtop:20000659.definition: Religions that follow the teachings of Jesus Christ and the Bible

medtop:20000661.label: Mormonism
medtop:20000661.definition: Christian religion founded in New York State in the 1820s that follows the teachings of Joseph Smith and the *Book of Mormon*

medtop:20000662.label: Old Catholic
medtop:20000662.definition: Members of a catholic church which started in 1870 and denies the dogma of the infallibility of the pope

medtop:20000663.label: Christian Orthodoxy
medtop:20000663.definition: Eastern rite churches which are characterised by their continuity with the apostolic church, their liturgy and their territorial churches, mainly in eastern and south-eastern Europe and the Middle East

medtop:20000664.label: Protestantism
medtop:20000664.definition: Christian denominations that were formed through the 16th century Reformation movement

medtop:20000665.label: Anglican
medtop:20000665.definition: Members of the worldwide Anglican communion which started in the 16th century in England as a breakaway church from the roman catholic church

medtop:20000666.label: Baptist
medtop:20000666.definition: Members of a Christian church which only baptises adults who truly believe in Christ

medtop:20000667.label: Lutheran
medtop:20000667.definition: Christians who follow the teaching of reformer Martin Luther

medtop:20000668.label: Mennonite
medtop:20000668.definition: Members of a 16th century Christian church which is against military service and baptising infants

medtop:20000669.label: Methodist
medtop:20000669.definition: Followers of John and Charles Wesley who tried to reform the Church of England in the 18th century and turned into a separate church

medtop:20000670.label: Reformed
medtop:20000670.definition: Christians who follow the teaching of reformers Johannes Calvin and Ulrich Zwingli

medtop:20000671.label: Roman Catholic
medtop:20000671.definition: Biggest Christian church worldwide tracing its origins back to Jesus Christ

medtop:20000672.label: concordat
medtop:20000672.definition: Treaty between the Holy See and another country for the regulation of ecclesiastical affairs in the territory of the latter

medtop:20000673.label: Confucianism
medtop:20000673.definition: A system of thought and behaviour originating in ancient China and based on the teachings of the philosopher Confucius

medtop:20000674.label: cult
medtop:20000674.definition: A group that consists of followers who are fully devoted to a charismatic leader. Members are sometimes exploited financially or subject to emotional or physical harm

medtop:20000675.label: Freemasonry
medtop:20000675.definition: A secret international society based on the principles of brotherhood, charity and mutual aid

medtop:20000676.label: Hinduism
medtop:20000676.definition: A religion and social system originating in India that includes a caste system, a belief in reincarnation and the worship of multiple deities

medtop:20000677.label: Islam
medtop:20000677.definition: Monotheistic religion that considers Muhammad as a prophet and the Qur'an as holy scripture

medtop:20000678.label: Jainism
medtop:20000678.definition: A religion beginning in the 7th-5th century BC in India that teaches a path to spiritual purity and enlightenment through a disciplined mode of life founded upon the tradition of ahimsa, nonviolence to all living creatures

medtop:20000679.label: Judaism
medtop:20000679.definition: A monotheistic religion and culture that follows the teachings of the Torah

medtop:20000680.label: nature religion
medtop:20000680.definition: Religions that believe nature and the natural world is an embodiment of divinity, sacredness or spiritual power, including indigenous religions practiced in various parts of the world, and modern Pagan faiths, such as Wicca

medtop:20000681.label: Zoroastrianism
medtop:20000681.definition: A religion originating in ancient Iran following the teachings of the prophet Zoroaster, predicting the triumph of good over evil and exalting the benevolent deity of wisdom, Ahura Mazda (Wise Lord), as its supreme being

medtop:20000682.label: Scientology
medtop:20000682.definition: A set of beliefs and practices invented by American science fiction author L. Ron Hubbard asserting that a human is an immortal, spiritual being (Thetan) that is resident in a physical body

medtop:20000683.label: Shintoism
medtop:20000683.definition: An indigenous Japanese polytheistic religion that revolves around kami, supernatural entities believed to inhabit all things

medtop:20000684.label: Sikhism
medtop:20000684.definition: An Indian Dharmic religion that originated at the end of the 15th century CE in the Punjab region, developed from the spiritual teachings of Guru Nanak

medtop:20000685.label: Taoism
medtop:20000685.definition: A philosophical and spiritual tradition originating in the 4th century BCE in China which emphasizes living in harmony with the Tao, the source, pattern and substance of everything that exists

medtop:20000686.label: Unificationism
medtop:20000686.definition: A religion founded in 1954 in South Korea following the teachings of Rev. Syn Myung Moon and known for its mass wedding ceremonies

medtop:20000687.label: interreligious dialogue
medtop:20000687.definition: Any form of communication between religions

medtop:20000689.label: religious event
medtop:20000689.definition: News regarding a religious event but not a festival or holiday

medtop:20000690.label: religious festival and holiday
medtop:20000690.definition: Holy day or period of observance in a religion which is sometimes a public holiday

medtop:20000691.label: Christmas
medtop:20000691.definition: Christian holiday that celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

medtop:20000692.label: Easter
medtop:20000692.definition: Christian festival commemorating the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

medtop:20000693.label: Pentecost
medtop:20000693.definition: Christian festival, celebrated on the 50th day after Easter commemorating the descent of the Holy Spirit, also known as Whitsun

medtop:20000694.label: Ramadan
medtop:20000694.definition: Holy month of fasting in Islam concluding in Eid al-Fitr

medtop:20000695.label: Yom Kippur
medtop:20000695.definition: Most solemn of Jewish religious holidays, observed on the 10th day of the lunar month of tishri by fasting and prayer from sunset to sundown the following day

medtop:20000696.label: religious ritual
medtop:20000696.definition: Established religious rituals such as mass, baptism, prayer meetings and bar and bat mitzvah

medtop:20000697.label: religious facility
medtop:20000697.definition: Any facility where a group carries out its religious rites

medtop:20000698.label: church
medtop:20000698.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Christian religion

medtop:20000699.label: mosque
medtop:20000699.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Islamic religion

medtop:20000700.label: synagogue
medtop:20000700.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Jewish religion

medtop:20000701.label: temple
medtop:20000701.definition: Generally an edifice identifiable as a place of worship

medtop:20000702.label: relations between religion and government
medtop:20000702.definition: Matters arising from the relationship between religions and a government, including the question of whether churches should pay taxes, the push to keep religion out of publicly funded institutions and the freedom, or lack of to wear religious symbols in a school setting

medtop:20000703.label: religious leader
medtop:20000703.definition: Person or persons who have a ritual, juridical or otherwise leading role in their respective church or religion

medtop:20000704.label: pope
medtop:20000704.definition: Head of the Roman Catholic Church worldwide

medtop:20000705.label: religious text
medtop:20000705.definition: Texts regarded as holy or important by a religion

medtop:20000710.label: biomedical science
medtop:20000710.definition: The application of biology-based science to medical fields such as research, health monitoring or medical treatment

medtop:20000711.label: biotechnology
medtop:20000711.definition: The scientific manipulation of living organisms and biological processes for scientific, medical or agricultural purposes

medtop:20000712.label: dentistry
medtop:20000712.definition: The medical profession and field of study devoted to diagnosing, preventing and treating oral conditions

medtop:20000713.label: pharmacology
medtop:20000713.definition: The medical profession and field of study concerned with the uses, modes of action and effects of pharmaceutical agents

medtop:20000714.label: veterinary medicine
medtop:20000714.definition: The medical profession and field of study devoted to diagnosis, prevention and treatment of medical conditions in animals

medtop:20000715.label: mathematics
medtop:20000715.definition: The study of structure, space, change and number in abstract, often using symbolic logic and language, and including subjects such as geometry, algebra or trigonometry

medtop:20000716.label: mechanical engineering
medtop:20000716.definition: The study and application of the design, construction and operation of mechanical systems

medtop:20000717.label: natural science
medtop:20000717.definition: The sciences that deal with matter, energy and the physical world, including physics, biology, chemistry and astronomy

medtop:20000718.label: astronomy
medtop:20000718.definition: The study of celestial objects through direct observation and theoretical models

medtop:20000719.label: biology
medtop:20000719.definition: The study of the anatomy, behaviour, origin, physiology and other aspects of living organisms

medtop:20000720.label: botany
medtop:20000720.definition: The study of the physical and physiological structure, genetics, ecology and other aspects of plants

medtop:20000721.label: genetics
medtop:20000721.definition: The study of genes in living organisms, and of their role in heredity, development or genetic adaptation

medtop:20000722.label: palaeontology
medtop:20000722.definition: The study of prehistoric life forms, geological periods and fossils

medtop:20000723.label: physiology
medtop:20000723.definition: The study of the vital processes, internal organs or functional mechanisms of living organisms

medtop:20000724.label: zoology
medtop:20000724.definition: The study of the biology, physiology, development, behaviour or other aspects of animals

medtop:20000725.label: chemistry
medtop:20000725.definition: The study of the composition and properties of matter on the scale of atoms and molecules, and of the reactions between compounds

medtop:20000726.label: cosmology
medtop:20000726.definition: The study of the origin, evolution, organisation and structure of the universe

medtop:20000727.label: geology
medtop:20000727.definition: The study of Earth's physical processes, material structures and its properties

medtop:20000728.label: horticulture
medtop:20000728.definition: The study and art of plant cultivation, including landscape and garden design and plant conservation

medtop:20000729.label: marine science
medtop:20000729.definition: The study of living organisms and environments in saltwater ecosystems

medtop:20000730.label: meteorology
medtop:20000730.definition: The study of atmospheric chemistry and physics, with a focus on weather forecasting

medtop:20000731.label: physics
