medtop:20001224.definition: A medical specialisation that focuses on the use of medical imaging (such as x-rays) and radiation to diagnose and sometimes also treat diseases within the body

medtop:20001225.label: eye care
medtop:20001225.definition: The medical profession and field of study devoted to diagnosing, preventing and treating eye conditions

medtop:20001226.label: surgical medicine
medtop:20001226.definition: A medical specialisation that focuses on the treatment of injuries or disorders of the body by incision or manipulation, especially with instruments

medtop:20001227.label: psychiatry
medtop:20001227.definition: A medical specialisation that focuses on the diagnosis, prevention and treatment of mental disorders

medtop:20001228.label: surgery
medtop:20001228.definition: The use of incisions made by medical instruments to investigate or treat a medical condition or injury

medtop:20001229.label: healthcare clinic
medtop:20001229.definition: Local medical facility or doctor's office associated with a general medicine practice, staffed by one or many doctors, focusing on outpatient treatment or giving recommendations to visit a specialist or hospital

medtop:20001230.label: environmental, social and governance policy (ESG)
medtop:20001230.definition: A company's business practices reflecting responsible social, ethical and environmental policies, sometimes known as corporate social responsibility

medtop:20001231.label: mixed martial arts
medtop:20001231.definition: A full-contact combat sport using techniques from various combat sports and martial arts

medtop:20001232.label: elderly care
medtop:20001232.definition: The long-term care of the elderly provided by residential institutions or by paid daily help in the home

medtop:20001233.label: name ceremony
medtop:20001233.definition: Event at which an infant, youth, or adult is given a name

medtop:20001234.label: graduation
medtop:20001234.definition: A ceremony, also known as commencement, at which a person receives a diploma or academic degree

medtop:20001235.label: funeral and memorial service
medtop:20001235.definition: A ceremony to memorialise a deceased person

medtop:20001236.label: wedding
medtop:20001236.definition: Marriage ceremony and the events and parties surrounding it, such as wedding receptions, engagement parties, bridal showers and hen or stag parties

medtop:20001237.label: anniversary
medtop:20001237.definition: The celebration or commemoration of a significant amount of years since an event or a notable person's birth or death

medtop:20001238.label: birthday
medtop:20001238.definition: A celebration on the anniversary of a person's birth.

medtop:20001239.label: exercise and fitness
medtop:20001239.definition: Physical activity with the purpose to maintain and improve health and wellness, gain stamina or for enjoyment

medtop:20001240.label: bodybuilding
medtop:20001240.definition: Competitions where participants perform specific poses to display their muscles that have been strengthened and enlarged through strenuous exercise. Competitors are judged based on criteria such as symmetry, muscularity and conditioning.

medtop:20001241.label: horseback riding
medtop:20001241.definition: The riding of horses for leisure or light exercise.

medtop:20001242.label: steeplechase (athletics)
medtop:20001242.definition: Obstacle race in athletics including barriers and water jumps

medtop:20001243.label: oil and gas
medtop:20001243.definition: The exploration, extraction, refining, transporting and marketing of petroleum products and natural gas

medtop:20001244.label: utilities
medtop:20001244.definition: The providing of basic services to the public, such as supplying water, waste removal, heating and cooling

medtop:20001245.label: infrastructure projects
medtop:20001245.definition: The construction of the fundamental facilities and systems serving a country, city, or other area, including roads, bridges, dams, tunnels, telecommunications and electrical grids

medtop:20001246.label: commercial building
medtop:20001246.definition: The construction of buildings for commerce and business, including office buildings, retail shops, restaurants, hotels and stadiums

medtop:20001247.label: collecting
medtop:20001247.definition: The hobby of seeking, locating, acquiring, organising, cataloguing, displaying, storing or maintaining items that are of interest to an individual collector

medtop:20001248.label: cosmetics
medtop:20001248.definition: Products applied to the body to enhance appearance, such as lipstick, eyeliner, foundation and nail polish, and the trends surrounding the application of these products

medtop:20001249.label: hairstyles
medtop:20001249.definition: Trends surrounding the cutting and styling of hair

medtop:20001250.label: body modification
medtop:20001250.definition: Actions taken to permanently or semi-permanently change body appearance, such as piercing and tattooing

medtop:20001251.label: tattooing
medtop:20001251.definition: A form of body modification where a design is made by inserting ink, dyes and pigments into the dermis layer of the skin to permanently change the pigment

medtop:20001252.label: piercing
medtop:20001252.definition: A form of body modification involving the puncturing or cutting of a part of the human body, creating an opening in which jewellery may be worn or where an implant could be inserted

medtop:20001253.label: cooking and baking
medtop:20001253.definition: Interest in preparing meals or baked goods

medtop:20001254.label: beer, wine and spirits
medtop:20001254.definition: Interest in the consumption, production and collection of alcoholic beverages

medtop:20001257.label: gardening
medtop:20001257.definition: Interest in working in one's garden

medtop:20001258.label: consumer electronics
medtop:20001258.definition: Electronic devices, such as computers, smart phones or televisions, designed and sold for personal use

medtop:20001259.label: political party convention
medtop:20001259.definition: Meeting of political party to nominate a candidate, choose a party leader or set policy

medtop:20001260.label: political committee
medtop:20001260.definition: A legislative sub-group that focuses on a specific area or action

medtop:20001261.label: head of government
medtop:20001261.definition: The highest official in the executive branch of a political entity

medtop:20001262.label: public inquiry
medtop:20001262.definition: An official review of events or actions ordered by a government body, including royal commissions

medtop:20001263.label: church elections
medtop:20001263.definition: Elections to choose leaders to run church organisations at various levels

medtop:20001264.label: infrastructure policy
medtop:20001264.definition: Policies regarding the development and maintenance of the fundamental facilities of a country, city or other area, such as communication, transportation and distribution networks

medtop:20001265.label: local government policy
medtop:20001265.definition: Policies for the development and maintenance of a local government area

medtop:20001266.label: political debates
medtop:20001266.definition: Organised debates between political candidates during their election campaign

medtop:20001267.label: Midsummer
medtop:20001267.definition: Northern European celebrations that accompany the Summer solstice

medtop:20001268.label: National day
medtop:20001268.definition: A designated day to celebrate a nation

medtop:20001269.label: New year
medtop:20001269.definition: The celebration of the end of one calendar year and the start of next

medtop:20001270.label: Halloween
medtop:20001270.definition: A celebration observed in a number of countries on 31 October with activities including trick-or-treating, wearing costumes, carving pumpkins, visiting haunted attractions, telling scary stories and watching horror films

medtop:20001271.label: All Saints Day
medtop:20001271.definition: Christian festival celebrated in honour of all the saints, known and unknown. Holiday is also known as All Hallows' Day, Hallowmas, Feast of All Saints or Solemnity of All Saints.

medtop:20001272.label: Walpurgis night
medtop:20001272.definition: The eve of the Christian feast day of Saint Walpurga, an 8th-century abbess in Francia, celebrated on the night of 30 April and the day of 1 May

medtop:20001273.label: baptism
medtop:20001273.definition: A Christian religious rite, sometimes also called a Christening, involving the sprinkling of holy water onto a person's forehead or immersing them in water, symbolising purification and admission to the Church

medtop:20001274.label: contraception
medtop:20001274.definition: A method or device used to prevent pregnancy

medtop:20001275.label: gig economy
medtop:20001275.definition: a labour market consisting of individual suppliers on short-term contracts or freelance work as opposed to permanent jobs, such as drivers or delivery workers

medtop:20001276.label: parental leave
medtop:20001276.definition: Time off work to give birth or care for a child

medtop:20001277.label: volunteering
medtop:20001277.definition: Unpaid work undertaken freely by individuals as a service to others

medtop:20001278.label: cooperative
medtop:20001278.definition: An organisation which is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits of their work

medtop:20001279.label: cryptocurrency
medtop:20001279.definition: An internet-based medium of exchange using cryptography to conduct financial transactions

medtop:20001280.label: hurricane
medtop:20001280.definition: A type of storm also called a tropical cyclone, which forms over tropical or subtropical waters

medtop:20001281.label: racquetball
medtop:20001281.definition: A racquet sport similar to squash in which the ball must bounce once before being struck and with a greater area of in-bound play

medtop:20001282.label: ringette
medtop:20001282.definition: A team sport usually played on ice by skaters using a straight stick. Players pass and shoot a rubber ring in order to place it in the opponent's goal

medtop:20001283.label: human smuggling and trafficking
medtop:20001283.definition: The illegal transporting of people from one country or area to another. When the result is forced labour or sexual exploitation, the crime is considered trafficking.

medtop:20001284.label: bullying
medtop:20001284.definition: Taking actions meant to harm, coerce and intimidate another person perceived as vulnerable. These actions can be taken in person or online.

medtop:20001285.label: vandalism
medtop:20001285.definition: Deliberately damaging or destroying public or private property

medtop:20001286.label: arm wrestling
medtop:20001286.definition: A form of wrestling in which two participants grapple arm-to-arm

medtop:20001287.label: supreme and high court
medtop:20001287.definition: matters related to supreme or high courts, including nominations and rulings

medtop:20001288.label: indigenous people
medtop:20001288.definition: People who are the original owners and caretakers of a given region, also known as native peoples, first peoples or aboriginal peoples, in contrast to groups that have settled, occupied or colonised the area more recently

medtop:20001289.label: sales channel
medtop:20001289.definition: Indirect or direct ways of bringing products or services to market so that they can be purchased by consumers

medtop:20001290.label: public housing
medtop:20001290.definition: Housing that is owned or managed by a government or nonprofit organisation and rented to tenants with the aim of making housing affordable. Eligibility for such housing arrangements varies country to country.

medtop:20001291.label: heating and cooling
medtop:20001291.definition: The business of supplying heat or cooling to private residences and commercial buildings

medtop:20001292.label: economic development incentive
medtop:20001292.definition: The offer of funds, financial incentive programmes or subsidies to stimulate businesses and the economy

medtop:20001293.label: streaming service
medtop:20001293.definition: Providers of entertainment (music, movies, series, etc.) that deliver the content via an internet connection to the subscriber's computer, TV or mobile device

medtop:20001294.label: crowdfunding
medtop:20001294.definition: The funding of a project or venture by raising small amounts of money from a large number of people, typically via the internet

medtop:20001295.label: outsourcing
medtop:20001295.definition: Business practice in which services or job functions are farmed out to a third party

medtop:20001296.label: shopping mall
medtop:20001296.definition: A large building or series of connected buildings that contain a variety of retail stores and food vendors

medtop:20001297.label: shopping district and high street
medtop:20001297.definition: Primary retail streets of towns or cities containing individual stores and restaurants

medtop:20001298.label: artificial intelligence
medtop:20001298.definition: An attempt to let computers simulate how the human brain works by applying statistical, heuristic or machine learning methods and algorithms to large datasets. Enables a long range of automatic functions like image recognition and categorisation.

medtop:20001299.label: surveillance
medtop:20001299.definition: Monitoring the activities of the individual through the use of cameras and data in order to prevent or uncover criminal activities

medtop:20001300.label: privacy
medtop:20001300.definition: The right of an individual or group to keep information about themselves private

medtop:20001301.label: sport achievement
medtop:20001301.definition: Records or honours earned by athletes for their performance

medtop:20001302.label: sports record
medtop:20001302.definition: The best performance to date by an athlete or team in a sport discipline

medtop:20001303.label: sports medal and trophy
medtop:20001303.definition: Award given to an athlete or team for placing in a sports competition, such as a gold medal at the Olympics or the Stanley Cup in ice hockey

medtop:20001304.label: sports honour
medtop:20001304.definition: Honour given to a player for achievements over a career, season or single event, unrelated to event outcome, usually awarded by a panel of judges or a popular vote. Examples include player of the game, most valuable player award or hall of fame induction.

medtop:20001305.label: padel
medtop:20001305.definition: Racquet sport typically played in doubles on an enclosed court

medtop:20001306.label: kiting
medtop:20001306.definition: Action sport where a person harnesses the power of the wind to propel themselves across water, land or snow on a board, snowboard or skis. Variations of the sport are called kiteboarding/kitesurfing, snowkiting or landkiting.

medtop:20001307.label: stand up paddleboarding (SUP)
medtop:20001307.definition: Water sport using a board and paddle to propel through the water while standing

medtop:20001308.label: krav maga
medtop:20001308.definition: Fighting and self-defence sport that combines elements from aikido, boxing, judo, karate and wrestling

medtop:20001309.label: cheerleading
medtop:20001309.definition: Cheer squads competing against each other to perform a routine that includes stunts, jumps and tumbling set to music. Squads are judged on difficulty and execution.

medtop:20001310.label: kickboxing
medtop:20001310.definition: Stand-up combat sport based on kicking and punching an opponent

medtop:20001311.label: sambo (martial art)
medtop:20001311.definition: Style of martial art originating in the Soviet Union that is recognised as a form of amateur wrestling

medtop:20001312.label: political leadership
medtop:20001312.definition: Positions of leadership within political parties and discussion around whether leadership changes need to be made

medtop:20001313.label: shootings
medtop:20001313.definition: An act of violence committed by individuals with the use of armed weapons

medtop:20001314.label: animal abuse
medtop:20001314.definition: The infliction of cruelty or neglect onto animals by humans

medtop:20001315.label: zoo
medtop:20001315.definition: A park where visitors can see both wild and tame animals that are kept in cages or enclosed areas

medtop:20001316.label: border dispute
medtop:20001316.definition: Diplomatic issues between two countries regarding territorial borders

medtop:20001317.label: child care
medtop:20001317.definition: Services and facilities that look after children while their parents are working or away, including daycare centres and programmes

medtop:20001318.label: pest and pest control
medtop:20001318.definition: Animals or insects that invade a human space causing destruction or unsanitary conditions and the methods for controlling or eradicating them

medtop:20001319.label: disinformation and misinformation
medtop:20001319.definition: The spread of false information regardless of intent

medtop:20001320.label: torture
medtop:20001320.definition: Intentionally inflicting severe physical or psychological pain in order to punish the victim or get the victim to take an action or give information

medtop:20001321.label: drowning
medtop:20001321.definition: When a person's airpipe and lungs become filled with water causing death or injury, most often caused by falling into or bathing in rivers, lakes or the ocean

medtop:20001322.label: poisoning
medtop:20001322.definition: When a substance in sufficient quantity adversely affects the body and its functions

medtop:20001323.label: sports coaching
medtop:20001323.definition: The staff responsible for the training and on-field management of a sports team

medtop:20001324.label: sports management and ownership
medtop:20001324.definition: The executive leadership and owners of a sports team

medtop:20001325.label: sports officiating
medtop:20001325.definition: Referees, umpires and other staff who enforce the rules of a sport from on the field of play

medtop:20001326.label: women's rights
medtop:20001326.definition: The rights of women to be treated equally as men, such as pay parity, feminism and bodily autonomy around abortion

medtop:20001327.label: women
medtop:20001327.definition: People who identify as female, focusing on the group as a demographic, and accomplishments, such as the first woman to achieve a milestone or serve in a role

medtop:20001328.label: men
medtop:20001328.definition: People who identify as male, focusing on the group as a demographic, and masculinity

medtop:20001329.label: 3x3 basketball
medtop:20001329.definition: A variation of basketball played three a side on one basketball hoop

medtop:20001330.label: canoe slalom
medtop:20001330.definition: Competitors navigate a canoe or a kayak on a white-water course, passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates on river rapids in the fastest time possible

medtop:20001331.label: canoe sprint
medtop:20001331.definition: Taking place on a flatwater course, multiple canoes take off at once and race each other to the finish

medtop:20001332.label: bmx freestyle
medtop:20001332.definition: Riders are given a fixed time to perform acrobatics tricks and skills, with tricks scored on multiple aspects including difficulty, originality, execution, height and creativity

medtop:20001333.label: road cycling
medtop:20001333.definition: Cycling events held on roads, including road races and time trials

medtop:20001334.label: track cycling
medtop:20001334.definition: Cycling competitions held on tracks, including sprint, team sprint, keirin, team pursuit, omnium and madison events

medtop:20001335.label: football 5-a-side
medtop:20001335.definition: A variation of association football in which each team fields five players and play is on a smaller pitch. An official Summer Paralympics sport.

medtop:20001336.label: goalball
medtop:20001336.definition: A team sport for athletes with a vision impairment, using a ball containing bells

medtop:20001337.label: online and remote learning
medtop:20001337.definition: Learning where a student and teacher are not physically present in the same location. Instruction can occur synchronously or asynchronously and utilizes technology such as video conferencing, online assessments and video conferencing.

medtop:20001338.label: education policy
medtop:20001338.definition: Government programmes and policies related to education, such as the funding of schools and standardised testing

medtop:20001339.label: wellness
medtop:20001339.definition: The active pursuit of good mental and physical health

medtop:20001340.label: mental wellbeing
medtop:20001340.definition: The personal pursuit of mental health through activities such as meditation, stress reduction, technology detoxes and journalling

medtop:20001341.label: regular competition
medtop:20001341.definition: A competitive sporting season where teams or individuals contend for a place in the standings or rankings

medtop:20001342.label: playoff championship
medtop:20001342.definition: A competitive tournament, often played after the regular season of a sports league by the top competitors to determine the league champion or a similar accolade. Can also apply to an all-in elimination tournament meant to produce a final champion.

medtop:20001343.label: final game
medtop:20001343.definition: Single game that determines the winner of a championship, such as the Super Bowl or Champions League Final

medtop:20001344.label: Catholicism
medtop:20001344.definition: Largest Christian religion in the world encompassing the Roman Catholic Church which is led by the pope, and Old Catholicism, a breakaway movement founded in 1870 that denies the dogma of infallibility of the pope

medtop:20001345.label: bar and bat mitzvah
medtop:20001345.definition: Young person becoming an adult in the Jewish faith

medtop:20001346.label: canonisation
medtop:20001346.definition: The declaration of a deceased person as an officially recognised saint

medtop:20001347.label: Shia Islam
medtop:20001347.definition: The second largest branch of Islam believing that the Prophet Muhammad designated Ali ibn Abi Talib as his successor

medtop:20001348.label: Sunni Islam
medtop:20001348.definition: The largest branch of Islam believing that the Prophet Muhammad did not designate a successor

medtop:20001349.label: atheism and agnosticism
medtop:20001349.definition: The belief that god does not exist or that it is impossible to know whether a god exists

medtop:20001350.label: Eid al-Adha
medtop:20001350.definition: Muslim festival marking the culmination of the annual hajj pilgrimage and commemorating the willingness of the Prophet Ibrahim to sacrifice his son

medtop:20001351.label: Hasidism
medtop:20001351.definition: Jewish religious group that believes that the Torah is the literal word of God and that carrying out this word is what gives meaning and purpose to life

medtop:20001352.label: Hanukkah
medtop:20001352.definition: Jewish festival, sometimes spelled Chanukah, observed by lighting the candles of a menorah

medtop:20001353.label: tsunami
medtop:20001353.definition: High and powerful ocean waves caused by an underwater land disturbance, such as an earthquake or volcanic eruption, known to cause significant damage and loss when they hit land

medtop:20001354.label: healthcare industry
medtop:20001354.definition: Goods and services to treat patients through curative, preventive, rehabilitative and palliative care

medtop:20001355.label: developmental disorder
medtop:20001355.definition: Conditions due to an impairment in learning, language or behaviour areas, such as autism, Aspergers and dyslexia

medtop:20001356.label: depression
medtop:20001356.definition: A mental health disorder characterised by persistently depressed mood and loss of interest in activities, causing significant impairment in daily life

medtop:20001357.label: anxiety and stress
medtop:20001357.definition: A mental health disorder characterised by feelings of worry, anxiousness or fear that are strong enough to interfere with one's daily activities

medtop:20001358.label: public health
medtop:20001358.definition: Organised public or private measures designed to prevent disease, promote health and prolong life among the population as a whole

medtop:20001359.label: pregnancy and childbirth
medtop:20001359.definition: Social and medical issues around pregnancy and giving birth including, doulas and midwives, obstetrics and medical concerns

medtop:20001360.label: fraternal and community group
medtop:20001360.definition: Social organisations whose members freely associate for a mutually beneficial purpose such as for social, professional or honorary principles. Groups include Rotary clubs, Lions clubs or Freemasons.

medtop:20001361.label: cyber warfare
medtop:20001361.definition: Cyber attacks, or suspected attacks, involving a government entity as either the sponsor or the target, or preventive measures against these types of actions

medtop:20001362.label: public transport
medtop:20001362.definition: Forms of transportation, such as buses and trains, that charge set fares, run on fixed routes and are available to the general public

medtop:20001363.label: taxi and ride-hailing
medtop:20001363.definition: On-demand ride service, provided by taxi companies or tech companies such as Uber and Lyft, the drivers who transport passengers and the rules and regulations imposed upon these companies within a region

medtop:20001364.label: shared transport
medtop:20001364.definition: A network of vehicles, such as cars, bikes and scooters, that can be rented by travellers on an as-needed basis for short-term use

medtop:20001365.label: business reporting and performance
medtop:20001365.definition: Measuring and reporting on the performance of a business

medtop:20001366.label: business restructuring
medtop:20001366.definition: Changes to the structure of a business or organisation

medtop:20001367.label: commercial real estate
medtop:20001367.definition: The building and sale of property used for business purposes rather than as a living space

medtop:20001368.label: residential real estate
medtop:20001368.definition: The building and sale of property to be used as living space

medtop:20001369.label: podcast
medtop:20001369.definition: Podcast networks and the people who create and distribute audio content, typically in a series format, to audiences

medtop:20001370.label: financial service
medtop:20001370.definition: Professional services involving the investment, lending or management of money and other assets

medtop:20001371.label: business service
medtop:20001371.definition: Services provided to business operations and for individuals, such as consulting, legal representation and job placement

medtop:20001372.label: news industry
medtop:20001372.definition: The production and distribution of content about newsworthy events through print, broadcast, video or electronic media

medtop:20001373.label: diversity, equity and inclusion
medtop:20001373.definition: Efforts that seeks to promote the fair treatment and full participation of groups of people who have historically been underrepresented or subject to discrimination on the basis of identity or disability

medtop:20001374.label: sustainability
medtop:20001374.definition: Actions by organizations, governments, and individuals in response to environmental problems

medtop:20001375.label: profit sharing
medtop:20001375.definition: A system by which employees are paid a share of the net profits of their employer. These earnings are distinct from and additional to regular wages.

medtop:20001376.label: corporate bond
medtop:20001376.definition: Corporate paper representing the loan of money at a fixed rate and for a fixed time to that company or government

medtop:20001377.label: war victims
medtop:20001377.definition: Individuals who are injured or killed in a war or armed conflict, including civilians

medtop:20001378.label: missing in action
medtop:20001378.definition: A member of the armed forces who cannot be located and has not been confirmed as either alive or dead

medtop:20001379.label: breaking (breakdance)
medtop:20001379.definition: Dancing competition featuring an urban dance style that originated in the United States in the 1970s with roots in hip-hop culture and characterised by acrobatic movements, stylised footwork, and the key role played by the DJ and the MC during battles

medtop:20001380.label: by-election
medtop:20001380.definition: An election used to fill an office that has become vacant between general elections because of the death of a politician, a resignation or other reason

medtop:20001381.label: recall election
medtop:20001381.definition: A special election to vote to remove an elected official from office before that official's term has ended

medtop:20001382.label: coalition building
medtop:20001382.definition: Political parties entering a power-sharing arrangement usually occurring when no single party has achieved an absolute majority after an election

medtop:20001383.label: zoning policy
medtop:20001383.definition: Polices around the division of land into zones, each of which has a set of regulations for new development

medtop:20001384.label: political party
medtop:20001384.definition: Organisation that coordinates candidates to run to represent that party in an election

medtop:20001385.label: political movement and association
medtop:20001385.definition: A collective of people with the aim to change government policy or social values in opposition to the status quo

medtop:20001386.label: communism
medtop:20001386.definition: Form of government that aims to replace private property and a profit-based economy with public ownership and communal control of the means of production and the natural resources within in society

medtop:20001387.label: democratic socialism
medtop:20001387.definition: Form of government that consists of a socialist economy in which the means of production are socially and collectively owned or controlled alongside a democratic political system of government with officials elected to office by citizens

medtop:20001388.label: theocracy
